name: Mempool.space
tagline: Open Bitcoin mempool, fee estimates, blocks, and address explorer API
description: Public REST API for Bitcoin blockchain and mempool data from mempool.space: fee estimates, recommended fees, mempool stats, blocks, transactions, addresses, mining pools, and Lightning Network endpoints. Fully open source and self-hostable; the public instance is free to use with fair-use rate limits.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public instance. Optional Enterprise API access may use keys; self-hosted instances need no public API key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public instance free with fair-use rate limits; exact free quotas not published on a pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise / dedicated API available via mempool.space for higher rate limits; details via sales

rate_limits: not published in detail for the public free API; fair-use limits apply; Enterprise plans offer higher limits
use_cases: get recommended Bitcoin transaction fee rates
fetch current mempool size and backlog stats
look up a Bitcoin address balance and transaction history
get details for a recent Bitcoin block by height or hash
inspect a transaction by txid including confirmation status
query Lightning Network node or channel data
